scripts.restart: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$connections = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($connections) { $procIds = $connections | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; foreach ($procId in $procIds) { Stop-Process -Id $procId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250; node server.js"
